description: Flat metadata schema for per-record data generated from hybridoma-derived monoclonal antibody screening against cancer cell antigens, including purification, binding characterization, and functional cellular assays.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the metadata record or antibody candidate.

project_id.descr: Identifier linking the record to a specific screening project or study.

experimental_date.descr: Date when the primary screening experiment was performed (ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2026-08-18).

operator_name.descr: Name or identifier of the person who performed the experiment.

institution_name.descr: Institution, laboratory, or organization where the experiment was conducted.

hybridoma_clone_id.descr: Identifier of the hybridoma clone used to generate the monoclonal antibody.

antibody_name.descr: Common name or internal name assigned to the antibody candidate.

antibody_isotype.descr: Antibody isotype, such as IgG1, IgG2a, IgM, IgA, or other.

antibody_species_origin.descr: Species in which the antibody was generated, such as mouse, rat, rabbit, or human.

antibody_light_chain_type.descr: Light chain type, such as kappa or lambda.

target_antigen_name.descr: Name of the intended cancer cell antigen target.

target_antigen_identifier.descr: Database accession or standardized identifier for the antigen, if available.

target_antigen_class.descr: Antigen class, such as protein, glycoprotein, receptor, or other biomolecule category.

cancer_type.descr: Cancer type or indication associated with the target antigen or test cell model, such as breast cancer, leukemia, or melanoma.

cell_line_name.descr: Cancer cell line used in binding or functional assays.

cell_line_identifier.descr: Standard cell line identifier, such as ATCC accession, if available.

cell_line_species.descr: Species origin of the cell line, such as human or mouse.

cell_line_state.descr: Cell state or phenotype relevant to the assay, such as adherent, suspension, primary, or engineered.

antigen_expression_level.descr: Relative antigen expression on the test cell line, if measured or known; acceptable values may include low, medium, high, or numeric expression score.

antibody_production_method.descr: Method used to produce the antibody, expected to be hybridoma-derived but may include subcloning or recombinant recovery details.

purification_method.descr: Purification method used for the antibody, such as Protein A, Protein G, affinity purification, or ion exchange.

purity_percent.descr: Estimated purity of the antibody preparation expressed as percent (%).

antibody_concentration_mg_ml.descr: Final antibody concentration in milligrams per milliliter (mg/mL).

buffer_composition.descr: Purification or assay buffer composition used for the antibody preparation, described as a free-text formula or standard buffer name.

storage_condition.descr: Storage condition for the purified antibody, such as temperature and buffer (e.g. -80 C, PBS, 50% glycerol).

elisa_performed.descr: Indicates whether ELISA binding assessment was performed for this record.

elisa_antigen_form.descr: Form of antigen used in ELISA, such as recombinant protein, peptide, lysate, or cell-based antigen.

elisa_coating_concentration_ug_ml.descr: Antigen coating concentration used in ELISA, in micrograms per milliliter (ug/mL).

elisa_primary_antibody_dilution.descr: Dilution factor used for the test antibody in ELISA, as a numeric dilution ratio.

elisa_binding_signal_od.descr: Observed ELISA optical density (OD) or similar signal value at the reported wavelength.

elisa_positive_control_signal_od.descr: ELISA signal from the positive control under the same assay conditions.

elisa_negative_control_signal_od.descr: ELISA signal from the negative control under the same assay conditions.

elisa_specific_binding_called.descr: Boolean call indicating whether ELISA data support specific antigen binding.

elisa_epitope_competition_result.descr: Result of any ELISA-based competition assay, such as competed, non-competed, partial, or not tested.

flow_cytometry_performed.descr: Indicates whether flow cytometry binding assessment was performed for this record.

flow_cell_suspension_density_cells_ml.descr: Cell suspension density used in flow cytometry assay, in cells per milliliter (cells/mL).

flow_antibody_concentration_ug_ml.descr: Test antibody concentration used for flow cytometry, in micrograms per milliliter (ug/mL).

flow_mean_fluorescence_intensity.descr: Measured mean fluorescence intensity (MFI) or equivalent flow cytometry binding signal.

flow_percent_positive_cells.descr: Percentage of cells positive for antibody binding in flow cytometry, %.

flow_isotype_control_mfi.descr: Mean fluorescence intensity from the isotype control.

flow_specific_binding_called.descr: Boolean call indicating whether flow cytometry data support specific binding.

apoptosis_assay_performed.descr: Indicates whether apoptosis-induction assays were performed for this record.

apoptosis_cell_line_name.descr: Cell line used in the apoptosis assay, if different from the binding assay cell line.

apoptosis_readout_method.descr: Method used to quantify apoptosis, such as Annexin V/PI, caspase activity, TUNEL, or similar.

apoptosis_antibody_concentration_ug_ml.descr: Antibody concentration used in the apoptosis assay, in micrograms per milliliter (ug/mL).

apoptosis_percent_positive.descr: Percentage of apoptotic cells or positive apoptotic readout, %.

apoptosis_fold_change_over_control.descr: Fold change in apoptosis relative to untreated or vehicle control.

apoptosis_statistical_significance_p.descr: P-value associated with the apoptosis result, if calculated.

proliferation_inhibition_assay_performed.descr: Indicates whether a proliferation inhibition assay was performed for this record.

proliferation_cell_line_name.descr: Cell line used in the proliferation assay, if different from the binding assay cell line.

proliferation_readout_method.descr: Method used to measure proliferation or viability, such as MTT, WST-1, CellTiter-Glo, or direct counting.

proliferation_antibody_concentration_ug_.descr: Antibody concentration used in the proliferation assay, in micrograms per milliliter (ug/mL).

proliferation_percent_inhibition.descr: Percent inhibition of cell proliferation relative to control, %.

proliferation_ic50_ug_ml.descr: Half-maximal inhibitory concentration for proliferation inhibition, in micrograms per milliliter (ug/mL), if determined.

proliferation_statistical_significance_p.descr: P-value associated with the proliferation inhibition result, if calculated.

lead_candidate_flag.descr: Boolean indicator that this antibody meets the study's criteria for advancement as a lead candidate.

lead_candidate_rank.descr: Rank order among screened antibodies, where 1 indicates highest priority; use null-like omission if not ranked.

selection_criteria_summary.descr: Brief textual summary of the criteria used to nominate the antibody as a lead candidate, such as affinity, specificity, functional effect, and developability.

notes.descr: Free-text notes, comments, or exceptions relevant to this record.
